name: S3-compatible object storage
summary: List, fetch and publish objects in any store that serves the S3 API, such as Ceph, Wasabi or DigitalOcean Spaces, at an endpoint you set.

fields.name: session_token
fields.label: Session token
fields.help: Only for temporary credentials, if the provider issues them.

settings.name: endpoint
settings.label: Endpoint host
settings.help: The provider's S3 endpoint host, without the scheme or port.

settings.name: region
settings.label: Region
settings.help: The signing region the provider expects; many ignore it.

settings.name: path_style
settings.label: Path-style addressing
settings.help: Off sends the bucket as a host name prefix, which the provider must resolve.

egress.note: A provider on another port is reached by setting the port setting; the egress approval then names that port.

operators.summary: List keys under a prefix, with sizes and ETags, as a manifest.
Fetch objects into the artifact store, hashed with BLAKE3, resumable by range.
Publish artifacts under a key prefix with multipart upload and a recorded digest.

notes: Use this when no provider connector exists. Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2, Alibaba OSS, Tencent COS, Huawei OBS and Volcano Engine TOS have their own. Providers differ in multipart and checksum support.
